title: CHISQ.INV: one figureless mention that may not even be about this surface
status_plain: CHISQ.INV occurs exactly once in the entire W109 corpus, in the sentence "BETAINV/CHISQ.INV inverter-limited no longer; forward error dominates." It carries no figure, no corpus and no denominator -- and it is ambiguous as to which chi-square inverse it means: the kernel that section describes is `chisq_inv_rt_kernel`, the RIGHT-tail inverse, while CHISQ.INV is the left-tail modern function. CHISQ.INV is also absent from the G3-01 header list. The weaker reading is published: this surface is named in an open row and no measurement of it exists.
evidence_locality_note: Every W109 battery (b14, b19, b20, b21, b22, b26, b30, b31) lives under `smart-fuzzer/work/` or `smart-fuzzer/cache/`, both gitignored in OxFunc.
open_question: The source does not say which chi-square inverse this sentence concerns, and no measurement of CHISQ.INV exists either way.
reader_warning: This record publishes no count and asserts no numeric comparison on record for CHISQ.INV. A qualitative sentence about a differently-named kernel is not evidence about this surface.
